name: Imran Khan
summary: Audio-Visual Director and Screenwriter crafting documentary, fiction, animation, and corporate films for global development organisations and brands.
about: I produce and direct high-impact audio-visual content for global development organisations, INGOs, and forward-thinking brands, including BRAC, Plan International, CARE, Swisscontact, and WorldFish. Specialising in documentary storytelling, social and behaviour change campaigns (SBCC), short fictions, and animated AVs, I translate complex development issues into compelling visual narratives. Although most of my work is concentrated around non-fiction, my portfolio also expands to fiction, corporate AVs, OVC, training module and more. My work equips clients to drive social impact, inspire empathy, and activate communities across digital and broadcast platforms.

Holding a degree in Media Studies and Journalism with a major in Digital Film and Television Production, I bring around 5 years of dedicated director-producer experience alongside a background in creative agency strategy. Having directed and executive-produced over 60 AV materials across Bangladesh, I manage end-to-end production pipelines—from initial scripting and concept design through complex field shoots, cross-functional team leadership, and final post-production.

I believe that audio-visual storytelling is one of the most powerful catalysts for human connection and systemic change. Combining the narrative discipline of filmmaking with strategic brand communication, I aim to craft visual stories that do not just inform, but resonate deeply on a human level. Every project is an opportunity to elevate marginalised voices, spark meaningful conversations, and turn critical awareness into measurable action.
quote: Every frame captures truth from the present, the past, and the untold future.
